content_text_body:
Team members who feel safe at work have an easier time focusing and doing high quality work. The goal is to create a culture of safety that focuses on rewards for safe behavior rather than punishments for safety incidents. 

### Create safety standards

Make sure your team has and understands safety standards. Create clear procedures and ensure that everyone is responsible for following them.

### Reward reports of issues

Team members need to feel like reporting a safety issue won't get them or their co-workers in trouble. It's key to create processes that reward rather than punish reporting issues.

### Track safety issues

Keep track of safety issues that arise to see if you can find patterns and prevent future issues. Do safety issues occur on a specific day of the week? Time? Area? Or process? Make detailed notes about what happened so you can prevent similar safety issues in the future.
